lemmas.primary_translation: the Norwegian resistance movement during World War II

definitions.text: (oftest i den uoffisielle formen gutta på skauen)
definitions.translation: (most often in the informal form “gutta på skauen”) (lit. the boys in the woods)

definitions.text: brukt om den norske motstandsbevegelsen (som lå i dekning i skogsområder) under andre verdenskrig
definitions.translation: used to refer to the Norwegian resistance movement, which was in hiding in forest areas, during World War II

examples.no: hytta ble brukt av gutta på skauen under krigen
examples.en: the cabin was used by the resistance fighters in hiding in the woods during the war
